messages:
sarah_marketing: Hey team, need a quick runtime sanity run for the launch deck. Goal: compare coldstart vs warmed p95 and per-token ms for redwood-14b-fp16 vs redwood-14b-q4. Hosting: us-west-2 (hosted).

miguel_runtime: Got it. Two clarifying Qs: (1) how do you define coldstart (idle time)? (2) how many samples per variant? Also sequential or small concurrency?

sarah_marketing: Coldstart = first request after 15m idle. Use sequential (concurrency=1). Samples: 1,200 per variant post-warmup. Warmup: 40 requests. Seed=2024. Streaming off for these runs.

priya_eng: 1.2k is fine for a slide snapshot, but add a footnote that p95 claims should be re-run at 5k for publication. We'll produce p50/p90/p95, per-token ms (server emit times), and CIs.

miguel_runtime: Plan: run short (25-40 tok) and long (180-320 tok) slices, models [14b-fp16,14b-q4], streaming toggled off. Artifacts: per-request CSV, token_events.csv, run_meta.txt, summary.png. Will include model load + GPU warm timings in metadata.

emma_ops: FYI us-west-2 GPU quota is limited today; i'll reserve a host for your window so job doesn't queue. Ping if you want Dedicated numbers later.

miguel_runtime: Exact reproducible command we'll attach in run_meta:
```
python infra/bench.py \
  --cohort cohorts/launch_slice_seed2024.json --seed 2024 \
  --model redwood-14b-q4 --region us-west-2 \
  --requests 1200 --warmup 40 --concurrency 1 --streaming false \
  --slices short,long --out artifacts/launch/314159_run_q4
```
Swap --model for fp16 runs. Tag run_id=314159_runset_A.

miguel_runtime: Kicking off job 88210 at 09:30 PT. deploybot: bench-job-88210 started :robot_face:

deploybot: job 88210 status: running

miguel_runtime: Interim note: long-slice q4 coldstart p95 looks ~46% higher than warmed p95 on the first pass. Posting interim CSV to artifacts/interim_314159_q4_long.csv. If we confirm >40% delta we'll include a slide callout recommending a 40-50 request warmup for demo traffic.

priya_eng: We'll compute CIs and add a README explaining metric definitions (server-side token timing vs client aggregate). Also include a one-line blurb for slides: "hosted/us-west-2; sample size=1.2k per variant; seed=2024; see artifacts for CSVs and scripts."

deploybot: job 88210 status: completed 6a7 artifacts uploaded: artifacts/launch/314159_runset_A.zip :robot_face:

miguel_runtime: Done. Summary PNG at artifacts/launch/314159_summary.png and full CSVs in the zip. If marketing needs a stronger claim we'll re-run the affected slice at 5k.

sarah_marketing: Great, thanks everyone  i'll draft the slide with the warmup note and link to artifacts. participants: sarah_marketing, miguel_runtime, priya_eng, emma_ops, jamie_product, deploybot
